target.statement: Global Centroid Deviation (GCD) of Algorithm 1 with alpha=1 on the isotropic synthetic dataset D_iso (k=3, d=2, n=10 nodes, p=0.7) at a given local sample size m_i, averaged over 10 runs — i.e., one point on the top-left panel of Fig. 1.
target.dataset: Synthetic scikit-learn blobs (D_iso, D_var, D_aniso), generated in-code

code_links: GitLab link mentioned in Sec. IV-A ('Source code of our experiments is available at Gitlab') but no URL is given in the PDF text

compute.basis: All data are tiny 2-D synthetic blobs generated with scikit-learn; the method is a few hundred iterations of Lloyd-style updates over 10 nodes and 10 runs, trivially CPU-bound; the main cost is re-implementing Algorithm 1 (E1-E3, M) and the distributed k-means baseline from the paper since no code URL is resolvable.

blockers: No resolvable code URL in the PDF (only 'available at Gitlab' with no link), so Algorithm 1 and the distributed k-means baseline must be re-implemented from the equations
Exact numeric values are only shown as log-scale plots, so matching a specific number requires digitizing figures or accepting qualitative agreement
Baseline [18] distributed k-means details (eta=2, primal-dual scheme) are only partially specified
title: Federated k-Means over Networks
